description: This Dart source file defines an API client class `ApiClient` for making HTTP GET and POST requests, handling authorization tokens, error handling through `ApiException`, and response parsing. It also defines a custom exception class and related types, serving as a core part of the frontend's network communication layer.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Represents an exception during API communication, carrying HTTP status and message details.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: Client for making HTTP requests to a REST API, with support for authorization tokens, headers, and response handling.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters and headers.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to the specified path with an optional JSON body and headers.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a full URI from the base URL, path, and query parameters.

methods.name: _buildHeaders
methods.description: Generates request headers, including authorization if a tokenGetter is provided.

methods.name: _handleResponse
methods.description: Processes the HTTP response, parsing JSON when appropriate or throwing an ApiException on errors.

methods.name: _safePreview
methods.description: Returns a truncated preview of a string for debug logging.
